walkthroughs.body_html:
Most UK pupils go to state schools — free, funded by tax.

Comprehensives take everyone. Academies are state-funded but run more independently.

• Grammar schools — entry test (11+) in some areas.
  • Faith schools — Church of England, Catholic, Jewish, Muslim and more.
  • Special schools — extra support.
  • Home schooling — parents teach.

About 7% of UK pupils go to private (independent) schools.

Fees can be £15,000–£45,000 a year. 💷

Some critics say this gives unfair advantages later in life.
